claim.text: Under a first-success T=16, R=64 ground-call path, the Rust solver builds 960 clause choices and clones 30,240 continuation pending-goal elements although none is redone.
claim.scope: Standalone Rust-native finite-term subset, 12 fixed profiles each on Linux ELF64 and i686 ELF32, opt-in feature only.
assumptions: All target clauses are identical and match
Feature-gated counters operate on actual engine sites
forbidden_promotions: No general ISO or GNU Prolog complexity theorem

specification.intended_object: Live operational counts for ChoicePoint push, continuation vector cloning, suffix materialization, redo, cut, trail and work tasks.
invariants: Redo pops=0 on known first-success cases
known_answer_cases: 16 heads x 64 goals predicts 960 choices, 30240 cloned elements, 2016 suffix elements, 0 redo
T=1 x R=64 predicts 0 clause choices
T=16 x R=1 predicts 15 choices, 0 cloned pending elements

implementation.environment: Ubuntu 24.04 GitHub Actions; rustc 1.85.1; x86_64 ELF64 and i686 ELF32 with real 32-bit GCC linker; no C GNU Prolog runtime link
implementation.live_entrypoint: engine::solve with Cargo feature choicepoint-profile, invoked by choicepoint-probe
implementation.representation: Thread-local typed counters incremented at actual ChoicePoint, Vec cloning, Work, BindingStore and cut sites

metric.name: Tuple of push, clone, pending-goal-element, redo, prune, binding-write, suffix-materialization and task counts
metric.units: logical occurrences and pending-goal elements, not bytes
equivalence_attacks: Ground atomic versus deep compound terms preserve counts but not bytes
Cuts and backtracking challenge no-redo shortcut

black_box: 12-case standalone Rust CLI probe with typed machine-readable counter output and intact answer Debug representation
structural: Profile calls are at current live push, clone, backtrack, cut and trail sites and disabled when feature off
property_based: Deterministic formula family T in {1,2,16,32}, R in {1,8,64}; not a randomized property framework
fuzzing: not applicable: 12 fixed deterministic profiling cases, prior parser stress remains separate historical evidence
historical: Feature-disabled Rust tests passed on both ABIs
Frozen Generation 14 and 15 semantic regression evidence retained

matched_baselines: Feature-disabled same-source Rust tests with same ABI/compiler
Conditional combinatorial formula under inspectable code path
negative_controls: Cut, redo and failing-head positive controls
controls.compute_parity: Same runner family, pinned compiler and real ABI targets; no timing comparison between instrumented and uninstrumented paths
controls.parameter_parity: Same source, query, Limits, compiler and API except the opt-in measurement feature
controls.sampling_parity: Deterministic one execution per scenario per ABI; exact logical counts only, no statistical sampling claim
controls.data_access_parity: Identical generated source/query fixtures and no external data or hidden oracle

preregistration.prediction: T=16,R=64 gives 960 choices, 960 continuation clones, 30240 cloned elements, 2016 suffix materializations, 0 redo
preregistration.primary_metric: Exact typed operation tuple matching frozen formula in 12 cases on two ABIs
preregistration.uncertainty_method: Deterministic structural witness: exact counter equality, no statistical interval; no external validity inference
preregistration.kill_condition: Any mismatched analytic count, unexpected answer order, backtracking/cut/undo control regression or feature-disabled build failure
preregistration.stop_condition: No new representation or performance attribution in the profiler PR before measured counters and independent future A/B ablation
preregistration.promotion_rule: Promote bounded observed operational counts from H to M only when exact dual-ABI CI + raw JSON + semantic controls succeed

Default semantics -> feature-disabled cargo tests both ABIs

result.observed: 12/12 cases each on ELF64 and i686, identical logical counts and answer Debug traces; T=16,R=64 matches 960 created, 30240 cloned pending-goal elements and 0 redo.
result.effect_size: Not a speedup: 960 alternatives created and unresumed; 30240 elements cloned. T=32,R=64 gives 1984 and 62496.
result.uncertainty: Exact under these deterministic inputs and code paths; external semantic validity, true bytes, wall-clock attribution, independent witness and held-out workloads unresolved.
